bk.skippedReplay: {n} replay ledger rows are not backed up (only live rows are).
bk.restore.records: Measured outcomes: {outcomes} rows, {oadded} new. Universe snapshots: {universes}, {uadded} new. Recorded gaps: {gaps}, {gadded} new. Trade notes: {notes}, {nadded} new.
bk.restore.notKept: {n} outcome records, universe snapshots or gaps will not be kept: their rows are not on this device or are older than it keeps, or there is no room for them. No row is removed to make room.

bk.err.too-large-plain: The backup would be about {size}, and {plain} once unpacked; the limits are 20 MB for the file and 160 MB unpacked. Export the ledger as CSV from the Ledger instead.
